description: Lists the matters on the panel matter register for the signed-in user's institution — forum, bench, case number, stage, next hearing, last update and claim amount — soonest hearing first. Filters by status: active (the default), closed or all. Use for an overview of the institution's matters with its panel counsel.

status.description: Which matters to list: 'active' (the default), 'closed', or 'all'.

name: list_my_matters
title: List panel matters
